messages:
frank: Starting the Acme marketplace initial ops thread. Need quick owners for: AWS KMS policy, GCP service account + roles, Azure offer manifest + redirect URIs. Also need legal to confirm trial/reseller language.

mina: I can handle GCP SA + roles. Will post minimal bindings and a create-service-account command.

oliver: I'll take Azure manifest + redirect list. Question: does Acme want auto-provision (SaaS) or manual token-based activation for Enterprise? This affects callback flow.

claire-legal: Telemetry/consent: must be opt-in during onboarding. Trial length ok at 14 days. If Enterprise uses reseller billing, we need a reseller clause "; will confirm if Acme requires one. Also ask for data residency preferences (EU-only?)

mina: GCP SA sample (replace PROJECT & SA_EMAIL):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts create acme-marketplace-sa --project=PROJECT
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding PROJECT --member="serviceAccount:SA_EMAIL" --role="roles/run.invoker"
```
Will add storage & pubsub roles if needed.

oliver: Azure manifest note: plan IDs must match offer plans. Redirect URI needs exact match in publisher portal. Sample snippet: "provisioning": {"uri":"https://acme.app/marketplace/provision"}. If auto-provision, we'll need to support signed JWT callback.

frank: Ops-bot create ticket please with owners assigned. Mina/Olivier/Claire to attach artifacts. Sync 09:00 PT tomorrow. Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
